cover.title: Why Are Cancer Drugs So Expensive?
cover.label: Rx

lines.text: Why does one cancer drug list at nearly $16,000 a month?
lines.say: Why does one cancer drug list at nearly sixteen thousand a month?

lines.text: That's Ibrance, a breast cancer drug: $15,741 for 30 days at 2024 list price.
lines.say: That's Ibrance, a breast cancer drug, at its twenty twenty-four list price.

lines.text: Global cancer drug spending hit $252 billion in 2024 at list prices, per IQVIA.
lines.say: Global cancer drug spending hit two hundred fifty-two billion in twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: Studies put R&D near $2.6B per drug (Tufts) and $2.8B for cancer drugs (JAMA 2020).
lines.say: Studies put research costs near two point six billion per drug, two point eight for cancer.

lines.text: Only 5.3% of cancer drug candidates went from Phase I to approval (2011-2020).
lines.say: Only five point three percent of cancer drug candidates reach approval.

lines.text: Patents run 20 years from filing; generics usually wait them out.
lines.say: Patents run twenty years from filing; generics usually wait them out.

lines.text: Critics cite pricing power: after rebates, US brand-name prices ran at least 3.22x other countries' in 2022 (RAND).
lines.say: Critics cite pricing power: after rebates, US brand-name prices ran at least three point two two times other countries' in twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: Example: one year of Ibrance is $188,892 at list, $94,452 at Medicare's negotiated 2027 price.
lines.say: Example: a year of Ibrance is about a hundred eighty-nine thousand at list, ninety-four thousand at Medicare's twenty twenty-seven price.

lines.text: Patients pay less: in 2027, Part D caps yearly out-of-pocket costs at $2,400.
lines.say: Patients pay less: in twenty twenty-seven, Part D caps out-of-pocket costs at twenty-four hundred dollars.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why one cancer drug lists near $16,000 a month
post.ig:
Why does one cancer drug list at nearly $16,000 a month?
Ibrance's 2024 list price was $15,741 for 30 days; Medicare's negotiated 2027 price is $7,871.
Global cancer drug spending hit $252B in 2024, up from $164B in 2020 (IQVIA).
R&D estimates range from $985M to $2.8B per drug, and only 5.3% of cancer drugs reach approval from Phase I.
RAND: US brand-name prices were at least 3.22x other countries' in 2022. Part D out-of-pocket cap: $2,400 in 2027.
Sources: IQVIA, CMS, JAMA 2020, Tufts CSDD, BIO, RAND.
News and education, not financial advice.
